messages:
Ava: Quick sync — launching webinar + benchmark thread tomorrow. Need final X/LinkedIn copy + hero image + 2 variations for A/B. Also need routing for inbound leads (MQL -> SDR). Can folks drop assets and confirm times? :rocket:

Liam: I can take scheduling. Suggest posts at 10:30 PT (X) and 2:00 PT (LinkedIn) day before, and 30m before live for reminder. Will queue in Buffer unless you want Hootsuite.

Priya: Drafts below — short X, longer LinkedIn, and a thread starter for X. Pick UTM and CTA and I’ll finalize.

Priya: X short: "Join our free webinar: making LLM inference predictable at scale. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_campaign=webinar_launch :calendar:"

Priya: LinkedIn long: "We built a runtime that shrinks token costs and keeps latency stable across clouds. We'll demo real benchmark numbers + rollout strategy. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_launch"

Priya: Thread starter: "Benchmark airtight: 3x throughput at 20% lower cost — how we did it. Highlights + live demo in the webinar. Thread👇"

Noah: Uploading hero + two carousel images to #marketing-assets now. Filenames: webinar-hero-v3.png, benchmark-snapshot.png, carousel-1.png

Noah: Alt text: "Engine room dashboard showing latency and throughput over time" for hero.

Sam: Tagging ops — I’ll set tracking in the campaign dashboard and confirm the webhook to the lead routing flow. We need the mapping: register -> mql -> sdr-inbox. @Marissa can you confirm SDR owners?

Marissa: Confirmed. For registrants from APAC send to SDR_APAC queue, EMEA -> SDR_EMEA, NA -> SDR_NA. I'll add notes to the CRM mapping doc.

Ava: Nice. Liam — can you paste the final schedule CSV here so I can sign off?

Liam: CSV below, will commit to Buffer after approvals.

Liam: ```
date,platform,time_utc,copy_file,asset
2026-03-25,X,17:30,priia_x_short.txt,webinar-hero-v3.png
2026-03-25,LinkedIn,21:00,priia_linked_long.txt,carousel-1.png
2026-03-26,X,17:00,priia_thread.txt,benchmark-snapshot.png
```

Priya: Small change — CTA should be "RSVP" not "Register" for LinkedIn. Also add `?utm_medium=social` to both links.

Liam: Got it. I'll update.

Ava: Final ask: add 2 engagement follow-ups for the thread — one immediate reply from our account with benchmark highlight, and one 24h later with webinar recording CTA. Priya, can you draft those two replies?

Priya: Drafts: Reply1: "Wait until you see the cost numbers — 20% savings w/ KV cache + batching :eyes:"

Priya: Reply2 (24h): "Missed the live demo? Watch the recording and see the benchmark breakdown: https://redwood.ai/webinar-recording?utm_source=social&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_followup"

Sam: I'll also set an automation to send registrants a follow-up email with the recording 1h after webinar.

Ava: Perfect. If no objections, I'll approve and ask design to export final PNGs at 2x for X and 1x for LinkedIn. :thumbsup:

Noah: Will do. Exporting now.

calendar-bot: Webinar event created: "Inference at Scale: Benchmarks + Rollout" — 2026-03-26 17:30 UTC. Join link in calendar.

Ava: Thanks team — tagging this for final sign-off at 15:00 PT today. :v:
